fixture_policy: Only disposable loopback-published Compose projects. Root seed uses original CoreSettings.save to disable optional external IP lookup for both backends.
Proxy-auth-only overlay explicitly trusts peers in both isolated services and is excluded from default/all suite selection. Synthetic client IPs separate login attempt budgets.
Proxy fixture restores/removes only its exact configuration/user rows; both Compose projects were removed after execution.
normalization: Generated channel IDs and valid UUIDs only in independent create lifecycles; readonly identity preservation checked before normalization.
Generated stream IDs and exact derived custom hashes only; automatic UTC timestamps checked recent.
JWT pairs normalized only after independent HS256 fixture signature, access/refresh type, exact subject, unique JTI and expiry/lifetime checks.
Only fixture origin in pagination links. Numeric JSON types remain exact.
remaining_gates: Allowed first-install writes remain501; enabled IP lookup cache/background refresh remains501.
Realtime policy/auth helpers pass pure unit tests but WebSocket/Redis worker transport is not wired or verified.
Core mutation side effects, M3U/EPG/DVR jobs, SQLite, other password hashers/upgrades, distributed auth throttles, session/CSRF/audit/inbox and uncommon parser/error forms remain incomplete.

prior_failed_attempt.cause: Independent account CRUD and startup sign-in tests shared the actual 3/minute per-IP budget; the foundation used an extra Rust login. Application throttling was preserved.
